profile_text.body:
Harvey is a San Francisco, California company that builds AI software for legal and professional services. According to its website, the platform is designed for law firms and corporate legal teams and is used to streamline contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation work. The company describes itself as built to meet the standards of leading professional service firms, and in 2025 reported customer wins, new product releases, and expanded global operations.

The company's primary product is Harvey AI, categorized as a Finance and Legal AI tool that covers legal assistance, contract drafting, and case research. The site also notes that Harvey publishes research findings and contributes to the open-source community around its AI models and methods.

The site tracks 181 law exposure entries associated with California for Harvey, reflecting noted concerns around law firm data exposure and attorney-client privilege considerations tied to the use of its platform. No litigation cases, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts at this time.
